connector.name: Scalix Cloud
connector.registryDescription: The agent-native cloud: database, functions, AI, storage, computers. 55 tools, one API key.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.scalix.world over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace world.scalix, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your Scalix API key> - create one free at https://console.scalix.world
